faqItems.q: Do you make jhalars for weddings and events?
faqItems.a: Yes — wedding and event jhalars, torans and garlands made to order in your colours, at any scale from a few dozen to several thousand pieces.

faqItems.q: Can I discuss custom colours and designs?
faqItems.a: Yes, for suitable order quantities. Share a reference photo or your palette and we will develop the design with you.

faqItems.q: How do I get prices for an order?
faqItems.a: Use the enquiry form or message us on WhatsApp at +91 81006 56258 for prices, samples and lead times.

faqItems.q: Do you work with decorators, wholesalers and distributors?
faqItems.a: Yes — we supply event decorators, wholesalers, distributors and organisations. Share your business details and the quantities you need.

faqItems.q: What are your minimum order and delivery timelines?
faqItems.a: Minimums start from a few dozen to several thousand pieces per design. Delivery depends on the design and quantity — share your date and we will confirm what is possible before you commit.
